RBI Junior Engineer JE Admit Card 2026 | Syllabus - Complete Details

RBI JE Recruitment 2026 Notification Released. Apply online for just 11 Junior Engineer (Civil & Electrical) posts from April 16 to May 6, 2026. Complete details regarding eligibility, salary, syllabus, and the application process are available here.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 16 April 2026
  • Last Date to Apply : 06 may 2026
  • Notification Release Date : 16/04/2026
  • Start Date : 16/04/2026
  • Last Date : 06/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 06/05/2026
  • Admit Card Released Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Date : 06/06/2026
  • Result Declare Date : As Per Schedule
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Junior Engineer (Civil / Electrical)
  • Civil Post : 7
  • Application Start Date : 16 April 2026
  • Last Date to Apply : 06 may 2026
  • Notification Status : Released
  • Start Date : 16/04/2026
  • Last Date : 06/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 06/05/2026
  • General / OBC : Rs. 450/-
  • SC / ST / PH : Rs. 50/-
  • Post Name : Total Post

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
